courseEvidence.description2: Teaches how to craft persuasive messages, influence opinions, inspire action and connect people. Draws on historical communicators from Aristotle to Barack Obama and applies stylistic techniques to students’ own writing and speaking.

An applied project creates narrative and storytelling material for an immersive educational setting concerned with Zeeland's climate and community.

sharedFoundation: First-year Personal & Professional Development contributes source evaluation, writing and collaboration. BENGATE102 contributes real study design, statistics in R and an empirical group project. Social Psychology designs a study proposal. The advanced methods course models behavioural evidence. Documentary and media courses undertake grounded analysis and production.
caseFinding: The closest option responds substantially to the target through persuasion, social psychology, strategic and organizational communication, audience-oriented empirical work and media interpretation. The second exchanges four business/organization courses for public-issue rhetoric, comparative political context and interpretive media and text work. The literary courses contribute analytical methods, with one directly comparing film adaptation. A third campaign or analytics direction lacks sufficient specialist implementation.
